title: Host grid columns cannot be sorted — header click selects the column instead
existing_state: Every column added to the host grid is forced to DataGridViewColumnSortMode.NotSortable in Dgv_Variables_ColumnAdded (Form1.cs:4306). Clicking a column header instead selects all cells in that column (Form1.cs:4264-4271). So a 200-row fleet cannot be ordered by hostname, site, port, or any custom variable column — rows live in raw CSV order forever. Professional grid tools (mRemoteNG, Excel, even basic DataGridView defaults) all sort on header click; here the gesture is repurposed with no replacement affordance anywhere.
recommendation: Add sorting via a modifier or context menu rather than breaking the existing header-click-selects-column gesture: e.g. header right-click menu gains 'Sort ascending / descending / Restore CSV order', or double-click on header toggles sort. Implement with DataGridView.Sort(column, direction) (grid is unbound — rows are added directly, Form1.cs:2306). Track original CSV order in a hidden index so 'Restore CSV order' is possible and Save CSV writes the original order (or explicitly the sorted order, user's choice). Connection-test visuals already survive row moves because state is keyed on row objects in a ConditionalWeakTable (Form1.cs:215). Verify the checkbox Select column and custom row-number painting (Form1.cs:4061-4085) behave after sort.
user_benefit: Sorting by hostname or by a site/role column is how operators audit a fleet ('are all DC1 switches checked?') and spot duplicates. Right now the data is frozen in whatever order the CSV was authored.

evidence.note: Dgv_Variables_ColumnAdded forces SortMode = NotSortable on every column
Header click is repurposed to select the whole column — no sort gesture remains
